scene_1_hook.text: You practice for hours every week. But when did you last train your ears deliberately?

scene_2_problem.text: Even hitting the right notes, you are still guessing. That subtle hesitation kills your musical flow.

scene_3_mechanism.text: EARPA changes that. Using the Alain Benbassat method, feel tonal gravity pull every note home.

scene_4_gameplay.text: Ten minutes a day. Sixty eight gamified levels and three D harp plucking build instant finger memory.

scene_5_cta.text: Stop hesitating. Unlock true confidence and start improvising freely by ear with EARPA.
